== Strategy ==

This is the Star Wars CCG Dark Side deck used by Dan Bojanowski to win the Virginia State Championships. Dan's strategy hints follow, below. The deck includes Mara Jade and Mara Jade's Lightsaber - we even have photodocumentation.

== Strategy ==

how it works:

A pretty standard Raltiir Ops deck. Plenty of anti-revolution stuff in there. Get AT-STs with pilots out for the flip and then establish Imperial Decree. Normally I start with Imperial Arrest Order, even if I suspect Revolution. Getting out the docking bay and generic site first turn should be enough to either draw more locations or an Evader/Crush The Rebellion. Once Raltiir is fortified, battle and drain elsewhere.
